title: New: Frame Only Orders
body_markdown:
Now you can submit **Frame Only orders** to participating lab partners, directly through[SpecCheck](https://mc.sendgrid.com/single-sends/49be6d2a-a49c-11f0-86a7-56c6ca9d2f91/stats/dashboard.speccheckrx.com) ! 🎉 This update brings every part of your ordering workflow into one place – perfect for stock frame orders, patient reorders, or any time lenses aren’t needed.


Log in to your dashboard and click **Create Order** to get started!
